summary: Aegon Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing meeting materials for an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held October 8, 2026, regarding a proposed corporate reorganization to domesticate and continue as a Delaware corporation (the Redomiciliation). The filing describes the definitive U.S. Shareholder Circular/Proxy Statement prospectus on Form F-4 and solicitation participants, explicitly disclaiming any offer or solicitation. No price per share, stake percentage, premium, advisor, or transaction price is stated. This is a routine EGM notice and proxy circular rather than a special-situation event, so it is classified as None; no deal terms are given.
